_about: Lift construction, replacement and upgrade events inside our window (winters 2015-16 to 2026-27) that change what a lift's name refers to, so a per-lift rule is not fitted across two different machines. Sources: the Palisades Tahoe operations blog (post slug and date given; read 2026-11-08) unless marked 'lift database' (liftblog.com, a hobbyist table, UNVERIFIED). 'era' ids are proposed lift-day columns (lift_era) so fits can split by machine. Wind statements are the operators' own claims, not measurements; the held-rate figures are counted from lift_days.csv (days with crest gust of 70 mph or more, lifts on the schedule) and are small samples.
names: Squaw Valley became Palisades Tahoe in Sept 2021 (Palisades side = Olympic Valley). Alpine Meadows became 'Alpine'. The blog archive was edited after the rename: a Nov 2016 post says 'Palisades Tahoe' where the original said Squaw Valley, so before Sept 2021 'Palisades Tahoe' in a blog post means the Squaw side only. Squaw One = Wa She Shu and Squaw Creek = Resort Chair (decision 22).

events.change: Siberia Express quad (Poma, 1985) replaced by a high-speed six-pack (Leitner-Poma)
events.winters_affected: 2015-16 is the first winter of the six-pack; no winter of ours has the old quad
events.source: blog 2016-year-review 2016-12-31 ('the new Siberia Express opened in 2015'); lift database
events.wind_note: crest lift, first to hold in wind; no before/after possible in our window

events.change: Hot Wheels (triple, 1998-2019) replaced by Treeline Cirque, a detachable high-speed quad (Leitner-Poma) with an unload-only mid-station and a 1,300 ft extension

eras.before: hot_wheels (lift under the name 'Hot Wheels', through 2018-19)

events.winters_affected: Hot Wheels in 2015-16 to 2018-19 posts (132 posts name it); Treeline Cirque from 2019-20. NOTE: rules/lift_groups.json says Hot Wheels has 'no successor seen': the successor is Treeline Cirque
events.wind_note: blog 2020-02-16: 'can run on storm days & in high winds' because its location is 'slightly more protected than other chairlifts on the ridgeline'. Counted: held for wind on 19% of 153 scheduled days with crest gust 70+, against 52% to 65% for Scott, Lakeview, Summit and Alpine Bowl and 26% for Sherwood. This is a location effect, not a rebuild effect. Opens first on Alpine opening days (2020-11-24 mid-station and Roundhouse)

events.change: New 8-passenger gondola (Leitner-Poma, 4 terminals, 33 towers, 96 cabins, 1,400 per hour) joining Palisades (Village) and Alpine (Alpine Lodge) over the KT-22 mid-station

eras.split_mode: from 2022-12-26 ran as two separate lifts (unload and reload at the KT-22 mid-station) until the interconnect software was finished
eras.full: one continuous loop after that; it can still be run as two separate lifts 'in case of inclement weather'

events.winters_affected: 2022-23 on; no gondola row exists before 2022-12-17. The tweets say which mode on a given day; today's table has one row, so mode is a missing column (operating_mode)
events.operating: 9am to 4pm, winter only (November to May); a shuttle runs between base areas when it is not running
events.wind_note: blog 2022-12-26 expected 'very high wind days' to affect it; a base-to-base link that can fall back to two lifts is a design for bad weather

events.change: Red Dog triple (Poma, 1989) replaced by a detachable high-speed six-pack (Leitner-Poma). Far East could not open until Red Dog's communication line and the new lift were finished. Haul rope re-spliced 2023-01-30 to 2023-02-01 (routine on a new lift)
events.winters_affected: 2022-23 on is the six-pack; the lift was out of service for the first part of 2022-23. Far East's early-2023 hold days depend on Red Dog
events.source: blog operations-update-10-days-left-at-alpine 2022-04-08 (last weekend of the triple); construction 2023-01-04; operations-update-5-feet-of-snow 2023-01-06; operations-update-100-terrain-open 2023-01-27; operations-update-red-dog-re-opens 2023-02-01
events.wind_note: counted: wind-held on 21% of 52 scheduled days with crest gust 70+ as the triple, 9% of 89 as the six-pack (small samples; BLOG_EVIDENCE found 32% against 25% above 80 mph)

events.change: New electrical system summer 2022; haul rope replaced for the first time since 1998 (season closed on the Funitel 2023-05-29, work from 2023-05-30)
events.winters_affected: 2022-23 had the new electrical system; 2023-24 on has the new rope. Operating limits at low snow: reduced to 6 to 8 people per cabin near Tower 4 (2021-12-28)
events.wind_note: BLOG_EVIDENCE: hold rate above 80 mph 42% before, 46% after; the Funitel has an automatic wind sensor that prevents running

events.change: Haul rope replaced, carriage overhauled, new steel hangers; closed from 2026-09-08 for the work
New lift access gates and smarter snowmaking for earlier, more reliable early-season operation
events.source: blog our-love-letter 2025-09-22 (one sentence; not verified further)

events.change: Renames (Squaw One, Squaw Creek), no machine change
events.winters_affected: posts before 2021-09 use the old names
